caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional figure of a person standing on a small rectangular platform base. The figure has dark brown skin and long, straight, dark gray or black hair. They are dressed in a yellowish tan dress with brown trim and puffed sleeves featuring red, yellow, and olive green hues. The person wears a necklace and headband decorated with green and yellow colors, and a single large feather extending from the headband. They are holding a long, twisted staff in their right hand. On their back, they carry a quiver containing green, red, and white arrows. A red cloth or cape hangs behind the figure, flowing downward to the base. The base and the objects on which the figure stands are painted in shades of gray and black. The background of the image is plain and beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Cigar Store Indian
